planets.name: TOI-1518 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1518 with a 1.9-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-1518 b was found in 2021 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1518. Its orbit and size follow Simonnin et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname SIMONNIN_ET_AL_2025): disc_year 2021, disc_facility Multiple Observatories, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 1.90261131, pl_radj 1.878, pl_bmassj 1.83

thermal.source: Cabot et al. 2021, dayside brightness temperature in the TESS band, assuming zero geometric albedo
thermal.chosen: the paper's own value, from a TESS eclipse 364 ± 28 ppm deep; no infrared eclipse is published
